description: Historical observation series for a single SARB indicator, identified by its TimeseriesCode (obtain codes from home_rates, current_market_rates, cpd_rates or exchange_rates). Examples: "MMRD002A" (SARB Policy Rate), "MMRD000A" (prime lending rate), "EXCX135D" (Rand per US Dollar), "CPI1000F" (CPI). Optionally bound the range with start_date and end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); omit both for the full available history. An unknown code returns an empty list.
name: sarb_timeseries
title: Sarb Timeseries
